rationale: For Outfall 001, the Flow row under the Part I Section A table headers (30-DAY AVG, DAILY MAX, 7-DAY AVG for both mass/load and concentration columns) specifies only 'Report MGD' in the mass/load columns and '***' in all three concentration columns, with 'Continuous Totalizing Meter' as the monitoring specification. Co-listed pollutants in the same table carry enforceable numeric limits (e.g., BOD5 at 1669 lbs/day and 30 mg/L), establishing by contrast that Flow lacks numeric effluent limits subject to exceedance comparison. The authorization language requires discharges from Outfall 001 to be 'limited and monitored ... as specified below'; for Flow, what is specified below is report-only MGD reporting and continuous totalizing-meter monitoring, not numeric limits. The proposition is therefore established.
